name: Cellframenet
fix_description: In migrate, do not use instantaneous pool reserves (getReserves) to calculate the token ratio for adding liquidity. Use a TWAP oracle or a fixed predetermined ratio. The current cell/eth calculation from spot reserves can be manipulated via flash loan before calling migrate.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires understanding a multi-stage DeFi attack chain: a preparatory setup, nested flash loans from two sources, repeated LP migration abuse, LP burn/unwind, and multi-DEX swaps across V2 and V3. While the code is not extremely long, the exploit depends on protocol-specific migration and liquidity mechanics rather than an obvious single-bug pattern, putting it beyond easy but short of truly hard.
